response.sql: WITH pair_averages AS (SELECT s.transref, t.tradekind, AVG(s.anlycount) AS avg_analyst_count FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS tr ON tr.transreg = s.transref JOIN trader AS t ON t.tradereg = tr.trdref GROUP BY s.transref, t.tradekind), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_analyst_count) AS mean_pair_average FROM pair_averages), type_averages AS (SELECT p.tradekind, AVG(p.avg_analyst_count) AS avg_analyst_count, AVG(p.avg_analyst_count - o.mean_pair_average) AS avg_above_overall_mean FROM pair_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS o WHERE p.avg_analyst_count > o.mean_pair_average GROUP BY p.tradekind) SELECT tradekind, avg_analyst_count, avg_above_overall_mean, avg_analyst_count / NULLIF(AVG(avg_analyst_count) OVER (), 0) AS relative_to_type_mean FROM type_averages;

assumptions.assumption: A matched trader with a NULL trader type forms a NULL trader-type group. AVG ignores missing analyst counts; pairs with no non-NULL count cannot pass the above-mean filter.
